action.term: <operation or behavior applied to the object>

object.term: <core entity or resource involved in the query>

has_exact_code: <0|1, 1 if the query may contain code element content, otherwise 0>

exact_code.text: <literal code-like string explicitly mentioned by the query>
exact_code.code_element_type: <when kind is code_element, choose from parsers/code_element_types.py; common options: function|class|variable|file|enum|unknown>
exact_code.source: <short explanation of where this literal appears in the raw query>

keywords.term: <important keyword or semantic phrase from the query>

target: <expected code element type such as function/class/file/module>

filters.relation: <relationship between the concept and the searching target>

exclude: <terms or concepts that should be excluded from retrieval>
